description: The Glowforge Pro is a desktop CO2 laser cutter and engraver with a 45 W laser and a cutting area of about 11 by 19.5 inches. In a makerspace, students use it to cut and engrave wood, acrylic, leather, paper and cardboard for prototypes, enclosures, signs and models, and to engrave glass and stone. Its passthrough slot takes thin sheets longer than the bed, so students can work on long pieces such as signs.

specs.label: Laser
specs.value: CO2 glass laser tube, 10,600 nm, rated at 45 watts

specs.label: Cutting area
specs.value: approx. 11" (279 mm) deep and 19.5" (495 mm) wide

specs.label: Pro Passthrough slot
specs.value: material up to 1/4" (6.3 mm) high, up to 20" (50.8 cm) wide, and as long as desired

specs.label: Power
specs.value: 110/220 VAC, 50 or 60 Hz; 800 W peak power consumption

specs.label: File formats
specs.value: JPG, PNG, SVG, PDF and other formats (web interface, internet required)

useRestrictions: Only trained users may operate it; use only laser-compatible materials (never vinyl/PVC or reflective metals such as copper or chrome), never leave a job unattended, and keep the Pro Shields installed except when a staff-approved passthrough job is running.
